rubriker.title: US Championships: Woodward takes down Caruana, Lee widens the gap
rubriker._rss_content: Sixteen-year-old Andy Woodward defeated defending champion Fabiano Caruana in round five of the US Championship to join Wesley So in the lead on 3½/5. Jeffery Xiong, Ray Robson and Abhimanyu Mishra also scored victories. In the women's tournament, Alice Lee claimed her fourth consecutive win to extend her lead to a full point. Meanwhile, Rose Atwell defeated defending champion Carissa Yip, who suffered her third loss in the event. | Photo: Lennart Ootes / Saint Louis Chess Club

rubriker.title: U.S. Championship: Round 6
rubriker._rss_content: Round 6 in Saint Louis on Thursday left both sections wide open. In the open, Fabiano Caruana bounced back from his first loss and Awonder Liang beat Levon Aronian to join Wesley So and Andy Woodward on 4/6. In the women's, Rachael Li ended Alice Lee's four-game winning streak, and Li, Lee and Thalia Cervantes now share the lead on 4.5.

Rafael Vaganian turns 75: Decades among the chess elite
rubriker._rss_content: Today, Rafael Vaganian celebrates his 75th birthday. In 1971, he became the first Armenian chess player after Tigran Petrosian to be awarded the grandmaster title by FIDE. He won numerous medals in team competitions representing the Soviet Union and Armenia, was at one point ranked fourth in the world and played for SG Porz in the German Bundesliga for many years. | Photo: Frank Hoppe

rubriker.title: Manaus Chess Open 2026: Ajedrez de élite y una cita que gana cada vez más protagonismo
rubriker._rss_content: El Manaus Chess Open 2026 reúne en plena Amazonía a grandes maestros, titulados internacionales y aficionados en un festival que combina competencia, difusión y convivencia. Con pruebas de rápidas, blitz, equipos y ajedrez clásico, el evento también destaca por su organización, las transmisiones en directo y las actividades culturales. Alexandr Fier abrió la competición con el triunfo en el torneo rápido, mientras figuras como Alexei Shirov encabezan la nómina internacional.
